description: Flight weather brief (METAR + TAF, GO/CAUTION/NO-GO) — Pilot-style weather go/no-go for a departure and optional arrival airport. from= ICAO id (KBNA; 3-letter US ids get a K prefix), optional to= arrival id, depart= ISO time (default now), kts= cruise speed (default 140, used for distance/ETE), ete_min= to override, min_cat= worst flight category you accept (VFR|MVFR|IFR, default MVFR), max_gust= kt (default 30). Returns current METAR and the TAF group valid at departure and at the estimated arrival time (prevailing plus TEMPO/PROB groups), flight categories computed from ceiling and visibility, wind/gust, thunderstorms/freezing precip/wind shear flags, great-circle distance in nm, and an overall GO / CAUTION / NO-GO with reasons. Source: NOAA Aviation Weather Center (public domain). Planning aid, not an official briefing. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_flight_brief
